title: Quad creates opportunities through community investment
summary: See how Quad's community investment efforts are transforming education and workforce development in southeastern Wisconsin.
body_markdown:
As technology reshapes industries and employers face growing workforce challenges, communities are looking for new ways to prepare people for the jobs of tomorrow while helping more individuals access opportunities today.


Across southeastern Wisconsin, Quad is partnering with educators, workforce organizations and community leaders to address both needs. From equipping students with practical artificial intelligence education to helping students gain workplace experience and removing transportation barriers to employment, the company’s community investments are focused on creating pathways to opportunity.


### Preparing students for a changing workforce


The future of work is evolving rapidly, and education plays a critical role in ensuring students are prepared for what’s next.


Last year, Quad and the Harry V. Quadracci family’s Windhover Foundation, supported the expansion of Waukesha County Technical College (WCTC)’s Applied AI Lab with a $1 million commitment. The expansion builds out a second floor of WCTC’s building Q, increasing capacity for hands-on artificial intelligence education, workforce training and business innovation, helping students gain experience with technology that is already transforming how organizations operate. Windhover’s donation kickstarted a capital campaign that enabled WCTC to officially break ground on the project over the summer.


Quad is also working with GPS Education Partners to provide high school students with work-based learning opportunities that combine classroom instruction with paid professional experience. The partnership began in 2024 when Quad started welcoming GPS Ed students into its Hartford facility. Earlier this month, Quad and GPS Ed celebrated the opening of the Quad Education Center, the organization’s ninth Center of Excellence in Wisconsin. Students spend part of their day in academics and part gaining hands-on, paid experience with local employers, helping them build technical knowledge, professional skills and confidence while exploring future career paths. As one of Wisconsin’s largest manufacturers, Quad sees programs like GPS Ed as an important way to help develop the next generation of skilled talent while strengthening the workforce pipeline for years to come.


Together, these efforts help ensure the next generation is equipped with the knowledge and experience needed to thrive in an increasingly dynamic workforce.


### Breaking down barriers to employment


Preparing people for careers is only part of the equation. Access to those opportunities matters, too.


For many workers, transportation remains one of the biggest barriers. Through Quad MKE and its Van Ambassador Program, Quad helps connect Milwaukee-area residents with reliable transportation to and from work, expanding access to careers that might otherwise be difficult to reach.


Operating through Quad’s recruitment, training and transportation hub, the program provides transportation for employees to travel to and from many of the company’s manufacturing facilities across Wisconsin. More than providing transportation, “van ambassadors” help employees navigate their work journey, serving as trusted resources and creating a welcoming experience from the first ride in to the trip home.


By addressing transportation challenges, the program opens doors to sustainable careers while strengthening connections between local talent and Quad facilities across southeastern Wisconsin.
